mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which lifts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 500k signals weakening residential investment and reduced construction-related earnings, which drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls below 500k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate revenues, which reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls below 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures per Capita below 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 growth falls below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressures and input costs, which reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
